lines.text: David calls on the LORD to come quickly and asks that his prayer be set before Him like incense.
David asks the LORD to set a guard over his mouth and keep his heart from evil.
David asks a Moabite king to strike him and calls the rebuke an act of loving devotion.
David says the people will listen to his pleasant words, and compares scattered bones at the mouth of Sheol to a potter smashing a jar.

wrong_details.true: one who plows and breaks up the soil

lines.text: David fixes his eyes on the Lord, seeks refuge in Him, and asks that the wicked fall into their own nets.
